headline: Drupal Commerce auth bypass under active exploitation; Binance $6.3B theft traced to DevOps laptop; GitLab and Cisco KEV fixes due Nov 1

bullets.text: New: attackers are actively exploiting a highly critical authorization bypass in Drupal Commerce core, CVE-2026-118539.

New: Binance links the $6.3 billion crypto theft to a compromised DevOps laptop; SecurityWeek reports the attack bears hallmarks of North Korea's TraderTraitor. Nearly $3 billion is frozen and withdrawals were paused.

CISA added actively exploited GitLab CE/EE RCE CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) and Cisco ASA/FTD VPN DoS CVE-2026-76418 to KEV, both due 2026-11-01. An attacker already tried the GitLab flaw against Alpine Linux's instance.
Attackers are exploiting Cisco SD-WAN flaw CVE-2026-20127 to deploy custom KeyDrift malware; the activity is tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network, used in four zero-day campaigns.

China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709 to reduce audit visibility; PHP2Shell and Fragnesia were chained to root firewalls. Exploitation attempts have also begun against Oracle EBS RCE CVE-2026-101767.

Breaches: iRhythm toll put at 8.2 million; Florida's education department says 4.9 million may be affected; hackers stole 2.6 million records from Sony's So-net; UNM Health is recovering after a ransomware claim.

actions: If you run Drupal Commerce, apply the fix for CVE-2026-118539 now and review access logs for authorization bypass attempts.
Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD for CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01; review logs for exploitation.
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 per Cisco's advisory and hunt for KeyDrift malware on SD-WAN components.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31; finish PHP updates for CVE-2026-109618/109619 (KEV due date passed).
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (KEV due 2026-11-11) and confirm Oracle's fix for EBS CVE-2026-101767 is applied.
Harden DevOps workstations with access to production or signing keys; Binance funds holders should use only official status channels.
